host.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1-3ubuntu2 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

workload.transport: RTSP over TCP from standalone go2rtc on 127.0.0.1 (lightNVR's own go2rtc integration disabled, as in the contract fixture)

detector.kind: local SOD CNN (unified detection thread, annotation-only because continuous recording is on)

workload.source: synthetic: ffmpeg lavfi testsrc2, 30 s clip, published into go2rtc by one always-on ffmpeg -re -stream_loop -1 -c copy per stream

retention.note: Recording retention/quota is unlimited in the fixture (storage.max_size = 0) so retention sweeps do not perturb the window. Evidence byte/queue budgets do not exist in disabled mode; X2 records the C1 budgets it runs with in results.feature.

definitions.latency.segment_interval_ms: Per stream, wall-clock interval between first sight (inotify) of consecutive new segment files; nominal = segment_seconds*1000. A recording-path stall (writer, rotation, DB insert under the global DB mutex) lengthens it.
definitions.latency.db_probe_ms: Round trip of GET /api/recordings?limit=1 with a session cookie every 250 ms; contends on the same global DB mutex as recording-path catalog writes.
definitions.gaps.metrics_recording_gaps_total: Delta of lightnvr_recording_gaps_total over the window (in-process detector, threshold 5 s).
definitions.gaps.catalog_gaps_total: Consecutive catalog rows per stream with start - previous end > 5 s (whole run, after warmup).
definitions.gaps.segment_interval_gaps: Segment intervals longer than nominal + 5 s inside the window.

limitations: Workstation measurement; go2rtc and the ffmpeg publishers share the host (their CPU is reported separately under resources.fixture_go2rtc_and_publishers).
No in-process packet-write latency histogram exists in lightNVR today; recording-path latency is the black-box segment-interval proxy plus the DB-mutex probe.

Synthetic testsrc2 content produces no VOC detections: the detector runs inference at its cadence but creates no detections. X2 needs a fixture that yields detections and must rerun disabled mode on that same source and binary.

detector.source: count of "sod_cnn_predict returned" info lines in server.log during the window
